body.x: Hisense participated in ‘CES 2018(Consumer Technology Show)’, the world’s largest IT consumer electronics show held in Las Vegas, the U.S.A. from Tues. 9th to Fri. 12th in Jan. and introduced new main TV products ‘HZ75U9A’ and ‘HZ75U9D’.
Hisense, the official TV sponsor of 2018 FIFA World cup, one of the biggest sporting events in the world, is trying to show the world the best football video possible on TV.

Hisense’s new super-high definition smart TV, model ‘HZ75U9A’ uses quantum dot display technology of a new generation. Slim body design, full metal frame texture are characteristics and it provides ultra-high brightness and 100 % DCI-P3 color area function. With amazing brightness control function, it makes pictures more realistic and natural.

Model ‘HZ75U9D’ is a latest 75-inch smart TV with 8K resolution panel and equipped with 4 times better clarity than 4K TV, super Loacle dimming dynamic back light technology, and the latest quantum dot technology supports back light, high color range function, maximum 1000 nits brightness and HDR technology.
Besides these, various models such as laser TV and vintage-designed ‘HZ43A69’ were introduced and attracted visitors’ attention.

CES, the world’s largest IT exhibition, is an exhibition of trends in the global consumer electronics industry, held annually in January by the American Consumer Technology Association (CTA). Aving News reported the most issues of CES, MWC, and IFA, which are world's top three tech exhibitions, during last 11 years. It is sending special reporters to CES for this year as well; reporting major issues in the world market and introduce Korea's major companies all over the world.
